name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Content that arrives as it scrolls into view.
use: A section, a card or a picture on a long page that should come in as the reader reaches it. The scroll position is the clock: nothing observes the element and no class is added. Use it on whole blocks, sparingly, and never on text a reader needs at once.

instead.when: Content is loading, not scrolling in
A row should keep passing by

platform.fallback: The content is simply there, as it is for a reader who asks for reduced motion

classes.name: reveal
classes.description: An element that fades in and rises 16px while its first stretch enters the viewport, and is at rest from then on

properties.name: --reveal-distance
properties.description: How far it rises; 0 for a fade alone

properties.name: --reveal-scale
properties.description: The size it arrives from, such as .96 for a picture

properties.name: --reveal-range
properties.description: How much of the element has entered when it has arrived; an element shorter than this has arrived once all of it is in view
